runsheet.short_description: Disconnect webinar audio+video from the auditorium. (Display the holding slide.)
[[Webinar Sentinel On-Site]] confirm where [[Zoom Master]] will sit.
Disable Zoom Chat and raised hand (for attendees).
runsheet.more_info: Chat > menu > attendees can chat with: nobody. Host Tools > attendees > raise hand: off.

runsheet.short_description: In the Zoom webinar, promote the 3 online panelists, the remote [[Industry Chair]], the Moderator, and the on-site panelist (if presenting slides) to panelist; promote [[Webinar Sentinel On-Site]] and backstage to cohost.

Test audio+video input+output with each online panelist and the [[Industry Chair]], and test screenshare with "Share sound" ticked (if any slides/audio). Seat the Moderator and the on-site panelist on stage.
Join the Zoom Webinar remotely (you will be promoted to panelist). Test your audio. Agree with the Moderator on when Q&A starts and how they will hand over to you for online questions.
Grab a mic and keep it for the whole session. Make sure the Moderator and the on-site panelist each have a mic too.
Connect webinar audio+video to the auditorium.
Open the Q&A panel (screenshot) and keep it open at all times. Stay muted with video off except when speaking.
The Moderator starts the session and introduces the panelists (including the remote [[Industry Chair]]).
runsheet.more_info: Note that the livestream view contains only the podium area, not the entire stage. Remind on-site speakers to stay in the camera view.

runsheet.short_description: Announce the agenda: 4 × 10-min sponsor presentations, then 30-min Q&A.
Keep time (10 min each). The Moderator introduces each next speaker.
Switch screenshare between presenters. Remind online presenters to tick "Share sound" if needed.

Sit on-site in the backstage but view only the Zoom Webinar on the provided laptop. Use the provided headphones. Upon issues, use judgement: Either unmute to raise the issue, or contact the [[Zoom Master]] immediately by walking to them.
runsheet.more_info: Pay special attention to the online panelists' audio, both in the webinar and in the room.

runsheet.short_description: Monitor the Webinar and report issues immediately to [#vol-alerts](https://ismir2026.slack.com/archives/C0CDNPPNJ0Z).
Sit in the corner of the audience, ready to fix online panelists' audio/video.
Keep time (30 min). Once on-site questions are done and the Moderator hands over, unmute (video on), pick the most interesting online questions and read them to the panel. Mark each as answered.
runsheet.more_info: On-site questions first, then online questions. No need to switch back and forth.

runsheet.short_description: Whenever a question from the on-site audience is taken, give your mic to them.
Demote panelists to attendees, especially when there is a subsequent session.
Clear the Q&A queue for the next event.
runsheet.more_info: Manually click 'dismiss' on every outstanding question.
